name: Prone Scapular Squeeze
steps: Lie face down on an exercise mat with your hands resting gently at the back of your head or beside your temples.
Keep your elbows flared comfortably out to the sides.
Gently squeeze your shoulder blades together, lifting your elbows toward the ceiling while keeping your head relaxed.
Hold the shoulder blade contraction for two full seconds while breathing naturally.
Relax your shoulders and allow your elbows to return toward the floor.
coaching_cues: Do not pull on your neck or lift your head high; the movement comes from your shoulder blades.
Think of holding a pencil between your shoulder blades at the peak of the squeeze.
Keep your breathing rhythmic and calm.
